primary_question.question: Why does my Puliyogare stick or tear?
evidence: Do not skip rinsing, or the rice may turn sticky.

related_questions.question: Why does rinsing or soaking affect my Puliyogare?
evidence: Do not discard the dark soaking water.

related_questions.question: Why is my Puliyogare too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not roast on very high heat.

related_questions.question: Why does my Puliyogare taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not over-roast fenugreek, or it will taste bitter.

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Puliyogare?
evidence: Do not over-grind until the sesame and coconut release oil.
